messages:
alex: Starting POC scoping thread for Skyline pilot. Need to lock down success criteria, integration plan (SDK vs direct REST), auth model, quota defaults, streaming requirements, and security notes. Sabrina — can you confirm their budget and timeline?

sabrina: They want a 10-business-day pilot, soft spend cap $5k. Primary use is mobile chat and support-assist widgets. They asked if streaming is mandatory for good UX.

tom: Streaming gives best UX for token-by-token typing. If they can't do websockets we can do chunked HTTP streaming. For SDK, our mobile JS SDK handles reconnection and incremental display.
alex: Proposed success criteria: (A) 95th pct streaming latency < 350ms, (B) human eval pass >= 88% on their 150 prompts, (C) avg pilot unit cost < $0.45 per 1k tokens. Are these acceptable?
sabrina: Customer accepts latency target but wants cost guardrails. They also want ability to pause traffic if they hit 80% of cap.
tom: For pause/alerts we can set Console billing threshold + webhook to their ops. Also propose per-key scoping so client SDK keys are limited to inference only.
alex: Integration plan (high level): Day 0-2 onboarding + SDK install; Day 3-5 integration and smoke; Day 6-8 run evals and iterate; Day 9-10 final tuning + go/no-go.
tom: SDK snippet for streaming (JS):
```js
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-skyline-v1', messages: [{role:'user', content:'hi'}] });
stream.on('delta', d => show(d.content));
stream.on('finish', ()=> console.log('complete'));
```
tom: Curl chunked fallback:```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream -d '{"model":"redwood-skyline-v1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
```
sabrina: Security question: they want audit logs and token rotation. For the pilot we can provide activity logs for keys and a manual rotation process; Dedicated/Private would give KMS/HSM options. I'll note that in SOW.
alex: Quotas default suggestion for pilot: 100 req/min, 25 concurrent streams, soft token cap 8k tokens/min. If usage spikes we can automatically degrade to smaller compatible model (e.g., skyline-mini) and surface that in Console.
tom: Retry guidance: exponential backoff for 429/5xx (200ms -> 500ms -> 1s) up to 3 retries, respect Retry-After header; use idempotency keys for non-chat calls. Also recommend client circuit-breaker after sustained 5xx.
sabrina: I'll request their 150-prompt eval set + any scoring script. QA-bot reminder to drop files into /shared/pilot-evals/Skyline when ready.
qa-bot: Reminder: upload evals to shared location and tag with pilot id.
deploy-bot: If you need deterministic latency we can spin a 1-GPU dedicated pool for testing. Estimated provisioning ~20 hours.
alex: Eval plan: run 150 prompts across temps 0.0 and 0.7, collect metrics: correctness, hallucination tags, latency distribution, token usage. Deliver one-pager with top 10 failure prompts and recommended prompt edits.
tom: Also enable KV prefix caching for repeated system messages to save tokens — could cut token cost ~20% for support workflows.
sabrina: Next steps: 1) I will collect prompts and budget confirmation; 2) Tom will send SDK and retry examples to their engineers; 3) Alex will author success criteria doc and timeline; 4) Sabrina will add security excerpt to SOW and confirm audit log availability.
alex: Thanks team — I'll draft the one-pager and ping when ready.
